news_items.headline: Dutch Bros Inc. Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 revenue $464.4M (+30.8% YoY) beat $449.37M consensus; adj EPS $0.16 vs $0.15 est; system same-shop sales +8.3%; 41 new shops opened to 1,177 total.

news_items.headline: Dutch Bros (NYSE:BROS) Q1 2026 Beat and Raised Guidance Can't Stem After-Market Selloff
news_items.summary: Despite the clean beat-and-raise, BROS sold off ~4.8% after-hours on classic 'buy the rumor, sell the news' dynamics following a strong pre-earnings rally.

news_items.headline: Dutch Bros reports strong Q1 growth, guides for 185 new shops this year
news_items.summary: Company raised FY2026 revenue guide to $2.05B-$2.08B and adj EBITDA to $370M-$380M; now expects to open at least 185 new shops in 2026 vs prior plan.

news_items.headline: Why Did Dutch Bros Stock Just Crash?
news_items.summary: Motley Fool covers post-earnings crash; cites profit-taking after pre-earnings rally and McCafe/McDonald's beverage competition overhang despite strong fundamentals.

news_items.headline: DA Davidson raises Dutch Bros stock price target on strong sales
news_items.summary: DA Davidson raised price target to $75 from $70, maintained Buy rating, citing strong sales execution and same-shop sales growth.

news_items.headline: UBS reiterates Dutch Bros stock rating on food rollout momentum
news_items.summary: UBS reiterated Buy rating with $85 price target citing food rollout momentum; analyst Dennis Geiger argues McDonald's competition concerns are overblown.

news_items.headline: Dutch Bros earnings up next: Can traffic momentum outlast rivals?
news_items.summary: Pre-earnings preview noting McDonald's McCafe expansion (crafted sodas, refreshers, Red Bull-based energy drink launching Aug 2026) as competitive overhang on Dutch Bros' Rebel energy drink franchise.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Post-Q1 (May 6-7): UBS reiterated Buy at $85 PT; RBC Capital Outperform $75 PT; TD Cowen reiterated Buy $73 PT; DA Davidson raised PT to $75 from $70 (Buy). Aggregated: 33 Buy / 1 Hold / 0 Sell.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 earnings just reported May 6, 2026 (revenue $464.4M, adj EPS $0.16, beat-and-raise). Next quarterly report (Q2 2026) expected early August 2026. Street focus shifts to FY2026 raised guide ($2.05B-$2.08B revenue, $370M-$380M adj EBITDA, 185+ new shops) and McDonald's McCafe competitive response.
